description: Multisig address fingerprints (NETWORK_IDENTITY.md NI-R15): cSHAKE256-32(S = shekyl/multisig-address-v2, X = len(tag) || tag || canonical payload), tag = shekyl/<network>, for one fixed 2-of-2 payload (B = 0xB1 x32, Y = 0x71 x32, KEM key i = byte i x1216) on each network. Written and checked by scripts/kat/multisig_fingerprint_oracle.py; read by shekyl-address's address_fingerprint_kat.
